data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,679k in the year, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business (2014: GBP 8,872k, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business.)
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 5.243m (a c.15.6% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 33.525m). The report describes a positive run-off deviation (net) of GBP 3.679k predominantly in Accident & Health; the gross movement is taken from the claims movement note (Change in prior year provisions: (5,243)k). This release reflects favourable claims development rather than changes from major catastrophes.
raw_causal_phrases: positive run off deviation of GBP 3,679k in the year, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business

The claims experience in 2015 does not reflect a significant increase in the level of catastrophe losses, but rather a number of risk losses that have impacted the account in several classes during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from 'At 1 January 2015' in the claims movement table. Gross prior-year movement taken from 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column) = (5,243)k -> release of 5.243m. The report also quotes a net run-off deviation of GBP 3,679k (net of reinsurance); gross figure used per rules. All source tables present amounts in GBP 000 (converted to millions here). A gross claims development triangle is present and was cross-checked. Some LOB allocation of the gross movement is not provided (the narrative only states 'predominantly in respect of Accident & Health').
